name: Victrays

sources.title: Victrays homepage - AI tools, prompts, ChatGPT plugins directory
Submit Your AI Tool to Victrays - listing options, requirements, FAQ

conditions: FAQ states 'you can submit your AI tool' for free, but the two published listing options are paid: Standard Listing $9.99 (72h review) and Priority Listing $29 (36h review, verified badge, boosted ranking)
Sign-in is required to submit ('Sign in to submit now' — Google login)
Free submission, if available, has no stated review time — the published SLAs belong to the paid tiers
requirements: AI-powered products only — 'AI must be an important part of the product'
Product must be live and publicly accessible with a working website and signup flow
Website must clearly explain what the product does and use HTTPS
Information must be accurate and original — copied descriptions risk rejection or slower review
No malware, deceptive claims, or prohibited/NSFW content
Submit each product separately — one listing per tool
preparation: Original short product description (do not copy homepage copy)
Screenshot of the tool's website at 1024x768, JPG or PNG only
A valid founder or company email address
workflow: Go to https://victrays.com/submit-ai-tool/ ('Submit Your Tool' in nav)
Enter tool name, website, original description, pricing, categories, and the 1024x768 screenshot

Choose a listing option: Standard ($9.99, 72h) or Priority ($29, 36h + verified badge + boosted ranking + 'instant indexing'); the FAQ implies a free submit exists but no free tier is shown in the options
Wait for review — Victrays checks the product is live, genuinely AI, and meets guidelines
On approval the tool gets a dedicated page + category placement and you get a confirmation email
To update the listing later, contact the Victrays team with the listing URL
watchFor: Contradictory pricing: FAQ says submission is free but both named 'listing options' are paid — treat the free path as a slow/unscheduled queue at best
Login is via Google OAuth only (popup)
Category page copy heavily promotes 'featured badge' — the paid Priority tier is pushed hard
Updates are manual via email contact, not a dashboard
countsAsLive: A dedicated tool page exists under victrays.com (linked from /ai-tools/ and category pages) with description, pricing, and screenshot
unknowns: Whether a genuinely free listing tier still exists and its review time (FAQ and pricing blocks contradict)
Whether listing links are dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
Whether the verified badge is paid-only
